description: This file contains template functions for converting between Windows Runtime (WinRT) objects and Platform::Object^, facilitating interop between WinRT and C++/CX. It includes necessary WinRT headers and defines conversion functions.

methods.name: from_cx
methods.description: Converts a Platform::Object^ to a specified WinRT type T using QueryInterface.

methods.name: to_cx
methods.description: Converts a WinRT IUnknown object to a Platform::Object^ of type T^.
